% =====================================================================
%  ESTIMAND LADDER  —  Lundberg, Johnson & Stewart (2021), ASR
%  "What Is Your Estimand? Defining the Target Quantity Connects
%   Statistical Evidence to Theory."  doi:10.1177/00031224211004187
%
%  A three-step figure: theoretical estimand -> empirical estimand
%  (under an identification design) -> estimation strategy.
%
%  TO ADAPT THIS TO YOUR DESIGN, edit only the macro block below.
%  Everything under "DO NOT EDIT BELOW" is the fixed scaffold.
%
%  Compile (TinyTeX on this repo, from the file's directory):
%    TINYTEX="/c/Users/kaizhu/AppData/Roaming/TinyTeX/bin/windows"
%    PATH="$TINYTEX:/c/Windows/System32" "$TINYTEX/pdflatex.exe" \
%      -interaction=nonstopmode estimand-ladder.tex
% =====================================================================
\documentclass[11pt]{article}
\usepackage[paperwidth=28cm,paperheight=18.5cm,margin=1.1cm]{geometry}
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb}
\pagestyle{empty}
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}

% ============================ EDIT HERE ==============================
% --- Treatment factor: the contrast that defines the estimand -------
\newcommand{\Tfac}{Motherhood}      % factor name (label in the conditioning bracket)
\newcommand{\Ttreat}{Mother}        % treated level
\newcommand{\Tctrl}{Non-mother}     % control / comparison level

% --- Conditioning factor: held fixed across both arms ---------------
\newcommand{\Cfac}{Employment}      % factor name
\newcommand{\Clev}{Employed}        % level it is fixed at

% --- Unit and outcome -----------------------------------------------
\newcommand{\unit}{woman}           % singular unit
\newcommand{\units}{women}          % plural unit
\newcommand{\outcome}{Y}            % outcome symbol

% --- Brace glosses (plain-English reading of each term) -------------
%  Keep the two columns grammatically parallel; the register shifts
%  per step: counterfactual -> factual -> mechanical.
\newcommand{\treatPot}{if she were an employed mother}        % step 1, treated
\newcommand{\ctrlPot}{if she were an employed non-mother}     % step 1, control
\newcommand{\treatReal}{actually are mothers}                 % step 2, treated
\newcommand{\ctrlReal}{actually are not mothers}              % step 2, control
\newcommand{\treatRecode}{recode all as a mother}             % step 3, treated
\newcommand{\ctrlRecode}{recode as not a mother}              % step 3, control
% ========================== END EDIT HERE ===========================


% ========================= DO NOT EDIT BELOW ========================
% Conditioning expectation: #1 = operator (E or \widehat E), #2 = treatment level
\newcommand{\condexp}[2]{%
  #1\mathopen{}\left(\,\outcome \,\middle|\,
  \begin{array}{rcl}
    \Tfac                  & = & #2\\[2pt]
    \Cfac                  & = & \Clev\\[2pt]
    \text{Covariates }\bar X & = & \text{Observed }\bar x_i
  \end{array}\right)}

\begin{document}
\large

% ----------------------------- STEP 1 -------------------------------
{\bfseries 1) Set the target.} Define a theoretical estimand.%
\hfill Requires substantive \textbf{argument}.\\[2pt]
Average difference in the \textbf{potential outcome} each \unit\ $i$ would realize
\[
\tau \;=\; \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\left(
  \overbrace{\outcome_i(\Ttreat,\ \Clev)}^{\text{\treatPot}}
  \;-\;
  \overbrace{\outcome_i(\Tctrl,\ \Clev)}^{\text{\ctrlPot}}
\right)
\]

\vspace{1.2em}

% ----------------------------- STEP 2 -------------------------------
{\bfseries 2) Link to observables.} Define an empirical estimand under a certain identification design.%
\hfill Requires conceptual \textbf{assumptions}.\\[2pt]
Average difference in the \textbf{realized outcomes} of \units\ with the covariates $\bar x_i$ of \units\ $i$ who
\[
\theta \;=\; \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\left(
  \overbrace{\condexp{\mathbb{E}}{\Ttreat}}^{\text{\treatReal}}
  \;-\;
  \overbrace{\condexp{\mathbb{E}}{\Tctrl}}^{\text{\ctrlReal}}
\right)
\]

\vspace{1.2em}

% ----------------------------- STEP 3 -------------------------------
{\bfseries 3) Learn from data.} Select an estimation strategy.%
\hfill Requires statistical \textbf{evidence}.\\[2pt]
Average difference in the \textbf{regression prediction} at the covariates $\bar x_i$ of \units\ $i$ if
\[
\underbrace{\hat\theta}_{\substack{\text{estimate of}\\\text{the estimand}}}
 \;=\; \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\left(
  \underbrace{\overbrace{\condexp{\widehat{\mathbb{E}}}{\Ttreat}}^{\text{\treatRecode}}}_{\text{estimated }\widehat{\outcome}_i(\Ttreat)}
  \;-\;
  \underbrace{\overbrace{\condexp{\widehat{\mathbb{E}}}{\Tctrl}}^{\text{\ctrlRecode}}}_{\text{estimated }\widehat{\outcome}_i(\Tctrl)}
\right)
\]

\end{document}
